app.name: AIStudioToAPI
app.one_liner: A proxy service that wraps Google AI Studio's web interface into APIs compatible with OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic formats using browser automation.

screens.name: Web Control Console
screens.purpose: Provides a local dashboard to monitor account status, service health, and model usage statistics.
primary_actions: Access VNC session for account management (Docker only)

rust_commands.name: setup_auth
rust_commands.purpose: Initiates the authentication flow to log into Google AI Studio and persist credentials locally.

rust_commands.name: start_service
rust_commands.purpose: Launches the API proxy server and browser automation backend.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add persistent auth storage in /configs/auth
week 1: Build API routers for OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic compatibility
week 1: Create Web UI dashboard on port 7860
week 1: Implement browser automation layer with Camoufox
acceptance_tests: Docker deployment mounts auth and data volumes and exposes port 7860 as documented.
Multiple Google accounts can be added via npm run setup-auth and switched without re-login.
Service successfully proxies an OpenAI-style chat completion request to Google AI Studio and returns a valid response.
Usage statistics are correctly written to /data/usage-stats.jsonl after each request.
